content: SwiftUI has no built-in cross-fade/slide for switching structurally different content driven by a Picker; the standard pattern is .transition(.asymmetric(insertion:removal:)) or .move(edge:) combined with .animation(_:value: selection) wrapping the switch, with transitions keyed by an .id so SwiftUI treats each branch as an identity change. matchedGeometryEffect is for animating a shared element (e.g. sliding pill background) INSIDE a custom segmented control, not for the content panes themselves.
